description: Read the live x402 payment terms for a service's report: the price, and one offer per settlement rail, exactly as the paid endpoint issues them. Use this to check a report's cost against your own spend policy before committing. Settlement happens over the plain HTTP endpoint named in the response, not through this tool -- signing a payment needs your own wallet, which no MCP client holds.

serviceId.description: The service id whose payment terms you want.

name: edge_get_report_terms
title: Get a report's live payment terms (x402)
